svg.title: Tri-state buffer
svg.desc: Tri-state buffer, IEEE 91 three-state logic convention; IEEE 315-1975 §16.2 triangle context only. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: in (8,36), out (96,36), en (46,8).
